notes.F-R43-3: radial_blur_window_cost(out, centre, amount, kind, limits) (PUBLIC SIGNATURE CHANGE: new BlurLimits argument; only callers are pigment's radial_blur_window and tests/ae_kernels.rs; composite calls radial_blur_window, unchanged) refuses path_cost(out, area) = (area x BLUR_SAMPLE_BYTES, area x 4) against the limits before the per-pixel walk, so the walk is at most max_work / 4 pixels. Overflow of the checked products is BlurError::Overflow (u32::MAX x u32::MAX rect). Test ae_kernels radial_hostile_rect_is_refused_before_the_walk: 10^6 x 10^6 rect refused OverBudget on bytes and on work, u32::MAX^2 Overflow, for both kinds and amounts 0/100/1000, through radial_blur_window and the cost function; no timing assertion.
notes.F-R43-4 folio: StudioCompositionEffect::colour_profiles: BTreeMap<param_key, StudioEffectColourProfile { colour_profile_id: ProfileBinding (crate::required, as StudioColor) }>, serde default + skip when empty (bytes unchanged: tests effect_stack_records_round_trip_and_an_absent_stack_is_byte_identical and colour_parameters_carry_a_profile_reference_additively). Validation: key must be a color row of the kind (InvalidField {layer}/effects/{id}/colour_profiles), id via Ctx::profile (InvalidId at .../colour_profiles/{key}; resolver issue at .../colour_profiles/{key}/colour_profile). Missing reference accepted at load. Shape chosen as an object with colour_profile_id so package externals.rs's PROFILE_KEYS walker reports each reference as an external colour_profile (a map of bare ids would not be found).
notes.F-R43-4 composite: At::colour: reference (null = document working_space_rgb) -> unchanged when it is the document blending_space in an encoded plan or its ICC bytes hash to ColourTag.profile_sha256; else hsk_studio_prism::WideEngine (relative colorimetric, no BPC, Studio reading UNVERIFIED D5) from the caller's ICC bytes into the plan profile bytes (must hash to the tag), alpha kept; Observe frame discarded (documented). Refusals: composition_effect_option with layer_id {layer}/effects/{effect_id}/{param_key}; cancel during conversion -> Composite(Canceled). New public API: temporal::composition::EffectColourProfiles::new(actor, plan_profile_id, plan_icc).with_profile(id, icc); CompositionTemporalSource::with_effect_colour_profiles(Arc<_>). Applied to EVERY colour parameter (Tint, Tritone, Glow A & B, and the SMB-AE-EFFECT-STACK-1 generators Gradient Ramp, Circle, Checkerboard), since STU-FX-118 covers every color parameter and the generators shared the same At::colour gap.
